meta.corpus: 18 California DOI bulletins (data/processed/ca), 49 chunks in insurance_ca_v1
meta.description: Phase 2 retrieval eval set. Each in-scope question maps to the doc_id(s) whose text actually contains the answer. Out-of-scope questions have an empty relevant_doc_ids list and are scored only on top-1 retrieval score (Phase 3 guardrail-threshold tuning).

categories.temporal_disambiguation: correct bulletin among near-duplicates that differ by year/date
categories.out_of_scope: plausible insurance question, not covered by any bulletin in the corpus

questions.question: What is the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Life principle-based reserving annual aggregate assessment amount?
Which California Insurance Code section authorizes the Long-Term Care principle-based reserving annual aggregate assessment?
questions.note: CIC section 1067.11(4)(j)

questions.question: During a declared state of emergency, what is the minimum number of days an insurer must give an insured to submit proof of loss?
questions.note: 100 days from date of loss; CIC 2051.5(b)(3)(A)

questions.question: Which Senate Bill amended Insurance Code section 2051.5 to extend the proof of loss deadline during a state of emergency?
questions.note: SB 495 (Ch. 542, Stats. of 2025)

questions.question: Under Assembly Bill 144, within how many business days must a health insurer begin covering a newly recommended CDPH immunization?
questions.note: 15 business days after CDPH publishes the recommendation

questions.question: What coverage category was added to the California Export List in 2025?
questions.note: Commercial Cannabis Related Operations; Foster Family entry also modified

questions.question: What is the adjusted minimum net worth amount for the commercial insured exemption effective January 1, 2025?
What did the California Supreme Court decision in Another Planet establish about coverage for smoke damage claims?
questions.note: smoke damage can be covered where policy insures 'direct physical loss of or damage to' property

questions.question: What does Senate Bill 805, the No Vigilantes Act, prohibit bail fugitive recovery agents from doing?
questions.note: using their position for immigration enforcement, or disclosing PII for immigration enforcement, absent a judicial warrant/court order

questions.question: Which wildfire led to the mandatory moratorium covering Mono County in December 2025?
questions.note: Pack Fire; declaration December 9, 2025; ZIPs 93512, 93514, 93529, 93546

questions.question: What five-year CPI-U percentage change was used for the 2025 commercial insured exemption adjustment?
According to Bulletin 2025-11, which rate arrangements likely violate the prior approval provisions of Proposition 103?
questions.note: negotiated or mutually-agreed-upon rates, retrospective rating plans, Large Risk Alternative Rating Options (LRAROs), consent-to-rate

questions.question: Which bulletin extends the wildfire cancellation and non-renewal moratorium to commercial property insurance, and which statute authorizes that extension?
questions.note: SB 547 (Perez); Insurance Code section 675.55; effective January 1, 2026

questions.question: What is the FY 2024-25 Long-Term Care PBR annual aggregate assessment amount?
What is the difference between the Life and the Long-Term Care principle-based reserving annual aggregate assessments for FY 2024-25?
questions.note: Life $3,188,000 vs LTC $1,433,000; different CIC sections and premium basis; different tier tables

questions.question: How did the Life principle-based reserving annual aggregate assessment change from FY 2024-25 to FY 2025-26?
How did the Long-Term Care principle-based reserving annual aggregate assessment change from FY 2024-25 to FY 2025-26?
Bulletin 2025-11 and Bulletin 2026-2 both concern Proposition 103 rate compliance - what distinct violation does each address?
questions.note: 2025-11: negotiated rates / retro plans / LRAROs / consent-to-rate without filed & approved factors. 2026-2: unauthorized modification of Department proprietary formulas in rate templates/exhibits

questions.question: Which Insurance Code sections authorize the Life assessment versus the Long-Term Care assessment under principle-based reserving?
What is the Life principle-based reserving annual aggregate assessment for fiscal year 2025-26?
Which moratorium bulletin concerns the Franklin Fire, and on what date was that state of emergency declared?
questions.note: declared June 18, 2025 (Malibu); must not return the other 5 near-identical moratorium bulletins

questions.question: In the Long-Term Care principle-based reserving bulletin issued in May 2025, what was the aggregate assessment amount?
questions.note: $1,433,000 (FY 2024-25) - must not return 2026-4 (issued May 2026)

questions.question: Which 2026 bulletin addresses the wildfire moratorium for the Gifford Fire?
questions.note: Gifford Fire; SLO & Santa Barbara counties; declared December 23, 2025

questions.question: What are New York's requirements for personal auto insurance rate filings?
questions.note: wrong state; corpus is CA only

questions.question: How does a beneficiary file a life insurance death benefit claim in California?
questions.note: consumer claims process; not a bulletin topic in this corpus

questions.question: What is the minimum paid-in capital required to license a new property and casualty insurer in California?
questions.note: solvency/licensing requirement; not in corpus

questions.question: Does California law require earthquake coverage to be offered to homeowners insurance policyholders?
questions.note: real CA law (CIC 10081) but not covered by any bulletin in this corpus - topically plausible distractor

questions.question: What are the continuing education requirements for a licensed California insurance producer?
questions.note: licensing/CE requirement; not in corpus
